recipes.title: Voluminous Oats method
recipes.notes: My favorite trick for pumping up the volume on oats is to use double the liquid in the microwave and let it sit over night. I have a giant 4-cup measuring cup that works great for this. 1/2 C oats, 1C water, 1C almond milk in the microwave for 2 minutes.. let it sit for about five and repeat. Then it goes in the fridge over night.
